name: observer
description: What past sessions learned. An observer runs at SessionEnd (the plugin agent agents/observer.md, run headless) and writes observations as rows in the vault's store (~/.ak/db/brain.db); the next session opens on a 'since you were last here' digest; `observer search → timeline → get` recalls them in three layers and `patterns · fold · forget` curate them; a Read hook says when a file has prior observations. CLI: `observer status|mute|unmute|show|try|store|types|search|timeline|get|patterns|fold|forget|shadow`, also mounted as `observer …` when ak is installed. Shares only the vault's data paths with the other kit plugins.

setup.summary: learns from each session once it ends
gives: ak observer search — what past sessions found, decided and got wrong, from the shell
a 'since you were last here' line when a session starts
a one-line pointer when Claude reads a file past sessions worked on
setup.changes: one headless Haiku call (claude -p) when each of your sessions ends, and a store at ~/.ak/db/brain.db
setup.note: on an Intel Mac the embed step is skipped (no zvec or fastembed wheel): search is keywords only
